findings.summary: Several client engagements are staffed and run end to end by Research Associates, the firm's most junior title, with no principal, engagement manager, or consultant on the team or in the room with the client, inverting the pyramid the firm's own overview promises.
findings.evidence: The Johnson, Lopez and Brooks commercial due diligence team is only Research Associates: d:0106 lists 'Present: Nicole Griffin, Research Associate ... Melissa Casey, Research Associate ... Cynthia Hart, Research Associate ... Barbara Banks, Chief Operating Officer', and the client status report d:0107 closes 'Prepared by Melissa Casey, Research Associate.' The engagement letter d:0102 confirms 'the daily work will rest with three of our people' and names only those three. The Garcia-Werner CFO engagement is the same shape, d:0174 'Present: Matthew Parrish, Research Associate; Pamela Miller, Research Associate; Mark Villegas, Chief Financial Officer', its status report d:0175 prepared by Pamela Miller. Yet the firm overview d:0119 promises teams 'senior enough that judgment sits in the room rather than being kept at a distance and consulted on occasion.'
